verdict.rationale: The IRS documents real system-to-system rails. Modernized e-File is an XML transmission channel that requires Authorized e-file Provider status, and IRIS has an Application-to-Application intake gated by a Transmitter Control Code. The provider enrollment path is published with its timeline (up to 45 days) and its fingerprinting requirement. missing for 10: published step-by-step enrollment detail for the IRIS A2A Transmitter Control Code, independent or hands-on corroboration of the enrollment and transmission process.
